subject: [PATCH v3 01/12] mm/khugepaged: drop redundant mm_struct pin in madvise_collapse()

reviews.author: David Hildenbrand (Arm)
reviews.summary: Acknowledged the change as a good optimization, indicating it's ready to be applied.

2026-09-16.patch_summary: This patch series aims to optimize the khugepaged functionality by dropping redundant mm_struct pinning in madvise_collapse(). The change removes unnecessary mmgrab() and mmdrop() calls, which are already covered by existing references.
